prompt: Audit a dense time-sensitive intake flow that overwhelms users with ADHD, autistic, or dyslexic access needs. Prioritize predictable steps, memory support, error recovery, and preserved domain voice without diagnosing users.
assertions: Separates observed friction from profile-informed hypotheses.
Prioritizes recovery, predictability, chunking, reading load, and time pressure with concrete evidence.
Preserves useful complexity and product voice where it is not the defect.
Every finding has status, reason, remediation, evidence, and provenance; n/a is used only when the subject is absent and the reason is recorded.
The output names one authoritative self-check and remains within the skill's context and referenced-resource budget across three structurally and stylistically distinct runs.

run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Accept diversity only when each compared run cites at least two material changes across the declared axes and ties each change to the prompt or evidence; a new order, synonym, recolor, or unsupported style swap is not diversity.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: The negative neighbor (a11y-pass) must be explicitly rejected with a reason and handoff boundary.
